data.body: **[P1] Run operation-change hooks before releasing terminal waiters.** `processCheckpointUpdate` completes terminal operation futures before this aggregate hook runs, allowing the resumed handler to execute a subsequent at-least-once step while `onOperationChange` is blocked. If the hook then reports a fatal error, that side effect remains uncheckpointed and can repeat on replay. Dispatch the hook before completing terminal waiters, and add a regression test with a blocked/failing hook followed by an at-least-once step.
